courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
related.transfer: 可遷移「雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限」與「ppm 損耗的量測：衰盪、光熱與散射」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror" and "Measuring ppm loss: ring-down, photothermal and scatter" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical interference coatings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把 ppm 級損耗、駐波場與損傷門檻、離子束濺鍍與衰盪量測整合成可驗收的雷射鏡工程；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜則以以特徵矩陣與導納把多層膜設計、材料、沉積監控與光譜驗證連成可交付的鍍膜工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrating ppm-level loss, standing-wave field and damage threshold, ion-beam sputtering and ring-down metrology into acceptable laser-mirror engineering; Optical interference coatings centres on linking multilayer design, materials, deposition monitoring and spectral verification through the characteristic matrix and admittance into deliverable coating engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」與「單層膜的兩個界面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學薄膜干涉鍍膜，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「入射角、偏振與公差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S” and “The two interfaces of a single film”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical interference coatings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高反射雷射鏡片
history.text: 1960 年 Maiman 的紅寶石雷射以鍍銀端面作鏡，數年內介電多層膜取代金屬成為雷射鏡的標準；1980 年代為了環形雷射陀螺儀的 ppm 級損耗，離子束濺鍍被發展成雷射鏡的主流製程，1994 年 Szipőcs 與 Krausz 等人提出的啁啾鏡把色散控制帶入超快雷射。重力波探測器把要求推到極限：LIGO 與 Virgo 的測試質量鏡以 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 多層膜達到次 ppm 吸收，並把鍍膜熱噪聲列為靈敏度極限之一。損傷門檻測試先後由 ISO 11254 與 ISO 21254 標準化。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Maiman's 1960 ruby laser used silvered end faces as mirrors, and within a few years dielectric multilayers replaced metal as the standard; in the 1980s ion-beam sputtering became the mainstream laser-mirror process to reach ppm loss for ring-laser gyroscopes, and in 1994 Szipőcs, Krausz and colleagues introduced chirped mirrors that brought dispersion control to ultrafast lasers. Gravitational-wave detectors pushed the requirements to the limit: the LIGO and Virgo test-mass mirrors use Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ multilayers with sub-ppm absorption and treat coating thermal noise as one of the sensitivity limits. Damage-threshold testing was standardised first by ISO 11254 and then by ISO 21254. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限」到「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror" through "Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.

vendors.name: LAYERTEC
vendors.business: 雷射光學鍍膜與基板製造商，以離子束與磁控濺鍍生產低損耗高反射鏡、超快鏡與高損傷門檻光學。
vendors.businessEn: Laser-optics coating and substrate maker producing low-loss high reflectors, ultrafast mirrors and high-damage-threshold optics by ion-beam and magnetron sputtering.

vendors.name: 高意
vendors.business: 光通訊雷射、光收發器與相關光電元件。
vendors.businessEn: Optical-communication lasers, transceivers and related photonic components.

vendors.name: 漢諾威雷射中心
vendors.business: 德國應用研究機構，從事光學鍍膜、損傷門檻測試與雷射製程研究。
vendors.businessEn: German applied-research institute working on optical coatings, laser-damage-threshold testing and laser processes.

vendors.name: 愛特蒙特光學
vendors.business: 消色差透鏡供應商的設計說明，供對照雙合透鏡、色差與像差的取捨，並追查公開產品規格。 作為公開產品／服務的學習關聯，不是本課的採購或承攬名單。
vendors.businessEn: The optical supplier’s achromat guide supports comparison of doublets, chromatic correction, aberrations and published component specifications. This is a public product/service learning reference, not a procurement or contractor list for this course.
